paragraphs.text: An independent DeepSeek Harness plugin to configure the actual Agent Teams teammate admission limit.
# dsh-agent-teams-optimizer
An independent DeepSeek Harness plugin to configure the **actual Agent Teams teammate admission limi
t**. It changes the number checked when `spawn_teammate` creates a new, durable teammate; it does no
t merely ask the model to use more teammates.
In the official Agent Teams profile, `agent-team` is configured with `maxMembers: 8`. The underlying
`TeamService` default is 16 when no profile override is provided. This plugin defaults to **16** an
d allows any positive safe integer.
## Install
First enable the official **Agent Teams** bundle. Then install the optimizer in the same profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart DSH after adding the plugin. In Web/Desktop, open **Plugins -> dsh-agent-teams-optimizer ->
agent-teams-optimizer -> Configure**, enter the desired **maxMembers**, and save. DSH stores the opt
ion in the current profile; changes are applied to the active Team service without needing to restar
t, provided the current official internal layout is compatible.
For direct profile configuration, set:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The plugin's own bundle patch only inserts `agent-teams-optimizer`. It intentionally does **not** ov
erwrite the official Agent Teams config row or any unrelated settings.
## Behavior

- The limit counts **teammates** only; the Lead is not counted.
- It is a cumulative, immutable rost
er limit, **not** a simultaneous-running limit. Even an inactive or failed member keeps its slot; in
creasing the limit permits more distinct names. Lowering the limit does not delete historical member

s.
- It changes the real TeamRoster admission field, so existing and future teams in the current Tea

m service honor the new value.
- Regular Subagent, workflow and nested delegation limits are not cha

nged.
- If Agent Teams is disabled, the optimizer remains idle. It binds automatically when the offi

cial `agentTeams` service becomes available.
- Disabling/unmounting this plugin restores the origina
l roster limit **only if no other component has changed the same field**.
## Implementation and compatibility
The official `TeamService` currently captures `maxMembers` in its `TeamRoster` constructor and offer
s no public runtime setter. Modifying the `agent-team` Cordis profile row is the **supported** metho
d for setting the limit at service startup. This plugin instead provides an editable, live UI by con
ditionally updating the existing roster's `maxMembers` property. This is **an undocumented internal
field**, not a stable DSH API.
The adapter checks that the official service and writable field have the expected shapes before chan
ging anything. If a future DSH release changes those internals, the plugin logs a warning and does n
ot pretend the setting took effect. It does not replace `spawnTeammate`, monkey-patch tool handlers,
or mutate the roster's historical records.
For a stable configuration-only alternative, use this profile override (the whole `config` object is
replaced by a patch, so include the other fields to retain the official explicit values):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
These two approaches should not be used to compete for the same limit at runtime. If both are presen
t, the optimizer treats the effective value seen on service mounting as its restoration baseline.
## Verify
When a compatible Team service mounts, check the DSH Host log for a line such as:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Test by creating more than eight distinct teammates in one Team. A ninth successful creation confirm
s that the **runtime** limit, not merely the prompt, has changed. Actual model behavior is a separat
e matter: raising the cap does not force the Lead to spawn more agents.
Run the unit tests with `npm test` (uses Node's built-in test runner).
## Requirements
- Official DeepSeek Harness Agent Teams service (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team`), not a

third-party Teams implementation.
- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-rc.1`; no maximum DSH version is impos

ed. Compatibility is verified by the runtime adapter on each mount.
- Node.js `>=22.19.0` for DSH.
